about_the_game:
Lost : Taboo Forest

I am just an ordinary human being who is no different from other people. But I will not let the people I love go just like that. The parents in our village never let people go towards that forest because anyone who goes there will never be able to return.

I can't see what people see with the 6th sense. I am sure that those who are invisible are never here, but I think that is wrong. I hear something that shouldn't be there. They exist but I never see them. I don't believe it but I have to believe it.

You play as a person who is forced to go to the forbidden forest to find his missing sister. in the forest there are many dangerous creatures but you can not see them. You are only given a flashlight to be able to explore the forest. the battery of the flashlight can run out, so you have to find a battery to be able to continue seeing in the dark.

With limited vision and the darkness of the night, making the atmosphere in this game more tense. You have to run when you hear something that doesn't come from you, but you can't run forever because you have limited stamina

There are objectives in the form of breakers for you to turn on, and most of them require a key. These keys are scattered in various places on the map. You need to find the key from the clue given by the ghost of a creature that only you can hear

short_description: Lost : Taboo Forest, is a game about an ordinary person who breaks the taboo and go to the forbidden forest to save his sister. You have to walk in the dark with only a flashlight and complete the existing objectives and avoid the sounds approaching you.
